## Overview

Performance on the prequestions, which participants in the Polio and TB conditions
answered before reading (five questions on their topic, 12 points). Responses were
scored by `grade_prequestions.R` (rules in `scoring_rubric.R`). Sample and exclusions as
in `R/data.R`.

```{r}
#| label: setup
# Shared setup and data (R/setup.R, R/data.R); run from the project root
if (!exists("dat")) {
  source("R/setup.R")
  source("R/data.R")
}
```

## Prequestion scores

```{r}
#| label: preq-perf
# Prequestion performance (data/derived/preq_scored_participants.csv, from grade_prequestions.R)
# for the analysed participants
preq_perf <- read_csv("data/derived/preq_scored_participants.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  filter(et_id %in% levels(dat$participant)) |>
  transmute(participant = et_id, condition = recode(et_group, Po = "Polio"), topic,
            pre = points / max_points, attempted = n_answered / n_questions)
stopifnot(n_distinct(preq_perf$participant) ==
            sum(n_by_cond$n[n_by_cond$condition != "Control"]))
preq_by_cond <- preq_perf |>
  group_by(condition) |>
  summarise(n = n(), pre_m = mean(pre), pre_sd = sd(pre), att_m = mean(attempted),
            .groups = "drop")

kable(preq_by_cond, digits = 3,
      caption = "Prequestion scores (proportion of the 12 points; attempted = proportion of prequestions answered)")
```

## Prequestion accuracy by condition

```{r}
#| label: preq-model
# Prequestion accuracy, TB vs. Polio condition: binomial mixed model of points earned on
# each prequestion (out of the question's maximum), analysed participants only, with
# random intercepts for participants and questions (each condition answered its own five
# questions, which differ in difficulty). This is the maximal random-effects structure:
# condition varies between participants and between questions, so no random slopes are
# possible. Means and the difference are on the response scale (percentage points),
# averaging model predictions over all participants and all ten questions
# (estimate = "average", as elsewhere).
preq_items <- read_csv("data/derived/preq_scored_items.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  filter(et_id %in% levels(dat$participant)) |>
  transmute(participant = factor(et_id),
            condition = factor(recode(et_group, Po = "Polio"), levels = c("Polio", "TB")),
            question = factor(questnum), points, max_points)
preq_glmm <- glmer(cbind(points, max_points - points) ~ condition + (1 | participant) +
                     (1 | question), data = preq_items, family = binomial,
                   control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"))
preq_cond_means <- as.data.frame(estimate_means(preq_glmm, by = "condition",
                                                backend = "marginaleffects", estimate = "average"))
preq_cond_diff <- as.data.frame(estimate_contrasts(preq_glmm, contrast = "condition",
                                                   backend = "marginaleffects", estimate = "average"))
stopifnot(as.character(preq_cond_diff$Level1) == "TB")

# text helpers (used by the manuscript)
pq_pct <- \(x) paste0(fmt_num(100 * x, 1), "%")
PQ_diff <- with(preq_cond_diff, sprintf("%s percentage points, 95%% CI [%s, %s], *z* = %s, %s",
                                        fmt_num(100 * Difference, 1), fmt_num(100 * CI_low, 1),
                                        fmt_num(100 * CI_high, 1), fmt_num(z, 2),
                                        sub("^p", "*p*", apa_p(p))))
PQ_mean <- \(cnd) pq_pct(filter(preq_cond_means, condition == cnd)$Probability)
PQ <- function(cnd, col) pq_pct(filter(preq_by_cond, condition == cnd)[[col]])

preq_cond_means |>
  transmute(Condition = condition, `Estimated score` = pq_pct(Probability),
            `95% CI` = fmt_ci(100 * CI_low, 100 * CI_high, 1)) |>
  kable(caption = "Prequestion score by condition (binomial GLMM, participant and question random intercepts)")
```

TB − Polio: `r PQ_diff`.
